notes.title: Update 2.1 - Mobile Release with Cross-Platform Saves Support!
notes.notes:
Get the game at the mobile stores

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AOGames.IdleFishing
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/idle-fishing-mobile/id6614782311

- Use a cloud account to effortlessly sync your save across all devices.

New Free Codes!

Mobile - 200 Gems - Can be only used on Android/iOS.
KentCity - for his help with the game - 10 Medals

New

There will be a star next to the best zone each day, so it will be easier to tell what is the best zone for today.
Added FPS Counter option to the settings under the "Video" Tab
You will be able to choose the FPS counter position - for example: Top Middle, Top Left, Bottom Right, and so on.
[Mobile] You will get away income if the application was unfocused for more than 3 minutes, so even if you don't close the game, the away income will work as intended.
Added "Recover from backup" to the panel you see when your save is corrupted(due to power outages and stuff like that), no need to manually recover from backups anymore.
[Mobile] Option to watch an ad to get extra away income, even if you don't instantly watch the ad, you will be offered to do it later for few minutes.
[Mobile] Claim the daily rewards from the premium shop multiple times by watching ads, for example get more gems/other currency per day by watching ads.
Made the fishing line more transparent
New setting to show/hide fishing lines
Many more things that I didn't write down, mostly new things to make the mobile experience better.


Changed/Fixed

Massive performance boost for Steam and Mobile versions
Catch X Common Fish daily quests will no longer be offered after the first rebirth.
Did it because after the first rebirth your chances of catching common fish is very low, so it takes long time to finish.
Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.


Planned Next Updates

Update 2.2 - New System - Excavation with an Upgrade Shop!
Update 2.3 - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the Discord or Steam Forums.

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Cross-Platform Saves with New Account System
notes.notes:
Hey! in preparation for the Mobile versions, I've added a Cloud Accounts system to the game, so it will sync between your PC and phone effortlessly.
Your created account will be used for all future games as well!
New

Cloud Account System

Auto syncs your saves between devices.
Ability to link your Steam account to it, so you can login with 1 click.
I've split the UI audio layer to 2 types

General UI mostly sounds on click
Notifications notification sounds like "Finished daily quest", "Finished holiday task"
More parts of the game is translatable now, like the timers of "5d 2h 25m until next reset"

Changed/Fixed
Now if you have the Rebirth upgrade get only 3+ Star pets, the egg opening animation will start from only 3 stars to avoid confusion. 
Tapping seagulls on touch screen devices now works.
The in-game auto clicker function was removed from the premium store.
Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.

Planned Next Updates

Update 2.1 - Mobile Update(Android + IOS) with cross platform save support.
Update 2.2 - New system & content - will be revealed soon.
Update 2.3 - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the Discord or Steam Forums.

notes.title: Update 1.9.1 - Performance Optimizations, Christmas Gifts, Improved Graphics
notes.notes:
New

Christmas Codes!

"Christmas2024Eggs", "Christmas2024Medals", "Christmas2024ChestHunt"
They expire at 10.1.2025(January 10th 2025)
Added "Buy Path" option to the Ascension Tree, unlock it in the start of the Rebirth Tree
Rendering optimisations that will improve your FPS in game and lower your GPU usage.
Alphabetical Notation!
More water options - "Realistic Performance" & "Cartoon"
Ability to change post processing between "High" "Performance" "Off"
Set Blurred UI update rate to "Every Frame"(like it is now) and "Every Second"
Added the option - "Return to main UI menu after closing" For example, you open the Daily Quests panel, switch to another panel, and then return, it defaults back to the main Tasks menu.
Changed/Fixed
Lowered(Buffed) the prices of end-game crewmate ads & cost hire mainly for 12+ star crewmates.
Now the odds of catching common fish is clamped to be 1% or above, so you can do it's daily quests and achievements.
Combined the "Post crewmate ads faster" upgrade in the rebirth tree into 1 instead of 5 to be less annoying.
Now the 4th/5th equipped pets will appear on most of the boats(that have enough space to display them)
Now on later rebirths you will see the actual Amber you will get per totem before it was stuck at 50 no matter what rebirth you were in.
Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.
Planned Next Updates

Update 2.0 - Mobile Update(Android + IOS) with cross platform save support
Update 2.1 - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the Discord or Steam Forums

notes.title: Update 1.9 - Rebirth - With HUGE Upgrade Tree, New Pet Abilities & 4/5th Slots
notes.notes:
New

Rebirth
You will be able to Rebirth once you finish the Ascension Tree and start earning Amber
Upgrade Tree of 110+ new nodes!
Some nodes have multiple steps.
The amount you get during your rebirth includes the amount of Totems(the last 3 upgrades) you have
New types of upgrades
increase bonding speed by X%
increase crewmate applicant's bonus values by X%
Get only 4 Star+ pets from eggs!
4th/5th Pet slots - Unlock them in the Rebirth Tree!
Now pets have 2 abilities instead of 1!
Nothing is removed, only added, so your existing pets won't get worse.
Now the remaining chest hunt currency left will be displayed inside the chest hunt panel.
It will only be displayed if you enable "Auto Start Next Game"
Changed/Fixed

 Now temporary bonuses like Gold and Silver-Per-Second will affect seagulls and active catch rewards!
 Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.


Planned Next Updates

Update 1.9.1 - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the Discord or Steam Forums
Update 2.0 - Mobile Update(Android + IOS) with cross platform save support

notes.title: Balancing for Update 1.8.2 - Buffed Income!
notes.notes:
A lot of you complained that your income went down after update 1.8.2, so I looked into it and changes.
- Lowered the prices in the ascension tree.
- I also buffed the crewmates + pets bonuses to active play.

notes.title: Update 1.8.2 - Crew Rework, Auto-Clicker Supported Active Catch
notes.notes:
New   Now Crewmates have 2 bonuses!   First Bonus:   Fish Value (Gold & Silver)  Gold Value   Second Bonus:   Seagull drops more currency  Active Catch has more rewards  Chest hunts have more rewards  Increases Silver Per Second %  More!    Now you can choose between 2 Active Catch versions:   Normal - Huge rewards  Auto Clicker Supported - 30% rewards   Auto Saver conversion in the Chest Hunt  Ability to collapse silver upgrade tiers  Built-in Auto Clicker:   Purchasable in the Gem Shop  Press Control to toggle it on/off   Ability to sort crewmates based on star level  Much more that I forgot to include 
Changed   Prices in the trader (only in late game) will increase faster when buying. 
Fixed   Many small bugs 
Planned Next Updates   Update 1.9 - Super Ascension  Update 2.0 - Mobile Update (Android + iOS) with cross-platform save support

notes.title: Update 1.8 - Tripled the content of the game! New 6 zones, 5 boats, 5 pets
notes.notes:
New

Tripled the size of the Ascension Tree!
6 New Zones
5 New Boats
13 New buildings!
7 New silver upgrade tiers!
5 New pets with new abilities!
 Some of them are able to auto collect currencies like medals, eggs, pet food, gems, tickets, chest hunt savers, and more - even while the game is closed!
Now rare currencies(medals, eggs, pet food, gems, tickets, chest hunt savers) will appear in chest hunts.(after you buy the upgrade that unlocks them)
Trader - New Feature

  Will offer the medals, eggs, pet food, gems, tickets, chest hunt savers currencies
  Every Week **3** Random Products will be offered to buy
  Product prices start at 1,000 Gold
  Each time you buy a product, its price increases by 10x.
  Every week, all the products will be randomized, and their prices will be reset.

Instantly convert 1 ticket into 3 medals after you finished the weekly fishing contest.
Golden Seagull!

  Is very rare - can use upgrades to make him show more often
  Will drop big rewards and currencies like medals, eggs, pet food, gems, tickets, chest hunt savers

New types of upgrades in the ascension tree
Some of the new nodes in the ascension tree will give now currencies.
More features that I forgot about, go in game to find them out

Changed

(Buff) Prices to upgrade pet star with pet food was reduced by a lot(only affects stars 5 to 15)
When your quest board levels up, you will instantly get an extra quest and will not need to wait for the following day.
When moving to another holiday, your finished holiday task's rewards will be automatically claimed so you won't lose them.
Fishing Contest time was changed from UTC time zone to your local time zone
Pet Abilities were changed/buffed
Much more stuff that I didn't track, you'll see while playing


Fixed

 Many small bugs


Planned Next Updates


 Update 1.9 - Crafting Update(each map will have special resources to fish->craft upgrades)
 Update 2.0 - Mobile Update(Android + IOS) with cross platform save support

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Pets Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
After a week of hard work the pets update is finally ready!

 I originally estimated for it to take 2-4 weeks but managed to get it ready in one weekːsteamhappyː
 I'm going for on a break for the next 2 weeks to rest a bit, so the next major update will be in 3-4 weeks.
 I'll be with my laptop to fix bugs and do small updates.

New

 12 New pets! Each pet has a different set of abilities, and they will get stronger as you improve your pet.
 Maximum 3 pet slots on the boat.
 New Currency - Eggs: Open them to get new pets. Get them daily & from chests.
 New Currency - Bond: As you play while your pet is equipped, you will be able to strengthen its bond with you to get better upgrades.
 New Currency - Pet Food: You use it to upgrade the pet stars - You get it by getting duplicate pets from eggs.
 Away income boost: Added many away income upgrades to the ascension tree.
 More things that I don't remember - I rushed to get this update ready.


Changed

 Away income boost: Added many away income upgrades to the ascension tree.


Fixed

 Many small bugs.


Planned Next Updates

 1.8 - Ascension Tree Expansion with new upgrades (maybe even new zones & boats).
 1.9 - Mobile Release (Android + IOS).

notes.title: Game Release + Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After a lot of hard work, the game is finally ready for release, I hope you'll enjoy it!

I plan to do weekly content updates in the coming months.
Current Planned Updates:

Fishing Contests - You will earn new currency, medals.
Medal Shop - You'll be able to spend there your medals, buying useful upgrades.
Pets - Hatch, breed and upgrade pets that will hang out at your boat, and will give you awesome bonuses.

If you want to suggest an update, let me know in the Discord
